content: Theme toggle with View Transitions: initial-load flash is fixed only by a blocking inline script in <head> that reads localStorage/matchMedia and sets data-theme before first paint (requires suppressHydrationWarning on html); document.startViewTransition only animates the toggle, feature-detect and fall back; Next's experimental viewTransition config is for route changes and not production-recommended; disable ::view-transition animations under prefers-reduced-motion.
